verdict: M163r2 fixes the r1 cross-hidden-lane semantic defect and is credible as an exact-SHA standalone Q8-input moment plus rank3-right frontend. It does not yet implement or prove the Q8 early-requant bridge, full BN1 population schedule, PAFT accuracy, equivalent-work speedup, or paper PPA.

shared_count_conditions: all 16 hidden lanes are present on every accepted beat
there is no lane-valid mask or ragged hidden-channel group
each physical lane remains bound to the same hidden channel across all spatial tiles
all spatial tiles for one 16-channel group are contiguous between tile_channel_start and tile_channel_last
moment_semantics.reason_not_global: The interface carries no hidden-channel base, spatial index, expected spatial extent, or batch index. It trusts start/last/tag and therefore cannot detect missing, duplicated, reordered, or lane-remapped spatial tiles.

operation_and_throughput.ii5_admission: Only when tile_valid is continuous and rank_ready/moment_ready stay asserted. The sealed SVA has one five-consecutive-beat cover, not a sustained back-to-back tile/channel recurrence or a full-network wall-cycle trace.
operation_and_throughput.dc_resource_crosscheck: Postcompile resources contain 32 explicit 8x8 square multipliers and 48 projection datapath operators, each with two signed 8x8 products, matching 32 squares plus 96 products.

rne.function_review: The RTL implements magnitude-based signed RNE with tie-to-even and signed INT8 saturation for allowed shifts 0..23; the -2^23 magnitude fits the 25-bit temporary.
rne.unsupported_contract_field: ties_to_even_and_saturation_reference_miter=true is not evidenced by explicit boundary counters or covers; a reference comparison alone does not show that a tie or saturation transition occurred.
missing_directed_cases: positive and negative exact half ties with even and odd retained LSB

dc.meaning: A reproducible pre-macro standard-cell estimate at 3 ns, TSMC28 NLDM, ZeroWireload and ideal clock. It has no placed routing, extracted clock tree, SRAM macro, SAIF power, or physical interface cost and is not paper PPA.
dc.hold_interpretation: +0.0001 ns is technically MET in this ideal-clock run but is effectively zero transportable margin.

cost_recompute.diagnostic: 3120 of the observed 3128 sequential-cell increase is explained by changing both scalar moment state and scalar moment snapshot into 16 lanes; this is diagnostic only because r1 was semantically invalid.

width_recompute.qualification: The 26/32/18 bound assumes the frozen B=1, T=10 maximum population of 19200 spatial positions and complete Q8 lanes; the 19-bit projection bound assumes exactly ten arbitrary signed INT8 products. Re-run VCS/DC and bind the population contract before admission.

issues.title: No checkpoint-bound Q8/rank3/PAFT network identity
issues.evidence: The DUT receives Q8 tile_data; it does not implement the fc1 accumulator-to-Q8 early-requant operation whose network semantics require admission. The TB uses synthetic factors and one shift=9. No frozen per-layer factors/scales, early-requant golden vectors, PAFT checkpoint, valid825 result, or network miter is bound.
issues.required_fix: Freeze exact-SHA factors, per-layer scales/RNE/saturation and the fc1-to-Q8 bridge; train/calibrate on a disjoint training cohort; pass predeclared valid825 AEE/AAE/tail gates against the frozen no_running baseline and hardware-order bit-exact vectors.

issues.title: No executable full-population, address, barrier and replay recurrence
issues.evidence: start/last/tag are trusted but there is no channel base, spatial index or expected HxW count. Rank packets also lack a spatial address. Coefficient generation, rank-state storage/replay, left projection, ATLIF, BN2 and residual commit are all outside the cut.
issues.required_fix: Drive actual stage populations 19200/4800/1200/300 through an address-bearing trace, prove lane binding and exactly-once coverage, then include coefficient/barrier/replay latency in an equivalent-work cycle model.

issues.title: RNE boundary claim is not covered
issues.evidence: Only shift=9 is configured, no tie/saturation counters exist, and SVA covers input extrema rather than projection rounding boundaries.
issues.required_fix: Add directed boundary vectors and explicit coverage counters for every case listed in independent_findings.rne.

issues.title: II=5 is structural no-backpressure throughput, not measured sustained system throughput
issues.evidence: One SVA five-beat cover matches one tile. The test injects 306 input gap cycles and periodic output stalls; no long back-to-back tile/channel recurrence or achieved wall-cycle utilization is reported.
issues.required_fix: Add at least hundreds of back-to-back tiles with ready=1 and counters for accept-to-accept II, then separately report backpressured trace throughput.

issues.title: Moment and projection widths are materially overprovisioned
issues.evidence: For the largest Q8 population, exact universal widths are sum26/sumsq32/count18, not 48/56/32. Ten signed INT8 products need 19 signed bits, not 24. Direct right-sizing can remove about 2460 FF before control changes.
issues.required_fix: Parameterize widths from frozen stage population and factor bounds; repeat boundary VCS, DC and overflow proof.

issues.title: Duplicate snapshot and buffering dominate sequential cost
issues.evidence: Moment state and moment output each use 1664 data FF; raw FIFO uses 2304 and quant_raw copies another 1152. Named data banks are 8704/9183 sequential cells.
issues.required_fix: After width reduction, evaluate state-ownership output with a channel-boundary handshake, or a ping-pong bank if overlap is mandatory; evaluate reading a held raw bank directly during requant to remove quant_raw and possibly one raw entry.

issues.title: tile_channel_start directly controls the widest state path
issues.evidence: The worst path is tile_channel_start to channel_sum_q[4][47], 88 reported logic levels, setup +0.1053 ns. Hold is only +0.0001 ns.
issues.required_fix: First shrink the accumulator to 26 bits; then compare an explicit channel-begin/preclear protocol or pipelined accumulation that removes start selection from the wide carry path.

issues.title: Logic-only PPA omits the dominant physical uncertainties
issues.evidence: ZeroWireload, ideal clock, zero macros and 2689 top-level ports exclude the routing and storage implementation of very wide moment/rank buses.
issues.required_fix: Use a realistic leaf wrapper, SRAM/register-file choice, floorplan, CTS/parasitics and SAIF/PTPX before energy, Fmax or paper PPA claims.

issues.title: No equivalent-work hardware baseline exists
issues.evidence: M163r2 implements the rank3 right half and moments, while dense full sn2 and rank3 left/correction paths are absent. Comparing the right half to a complete dense operator would be asymmetric.
issues.required_fix: Model dense no_running BN plus sn2 and full admitted rank3 right+correction+left under the same lanes, memories, clock and backpressure. Preserve M161 fair movement numbers as bit sensitivities only.

issues.title: Directed moment populations are tiny
issues.evidence: The TB uses 1..5 tiles per channel, while production requires up to 19200 spatial tiles per hidden lane group.
issues.required_fix: Add maximum-population and near-overflow tests after width freezing.

issues.title: Unequal-lane SVA cover observes only lanes 0 and 1
issues.evidence: The scoreboard compares all 16 lanes, but the cover does not demonstrate diversity across every lane.
issues.required_fix: Add per-lane non-alias coverage or a compact all-lanes signature cover.

issues.title: Wide moment output is not an integration-ready transaction
issues.evidence: Sixteen 48-bit sums plus sixteen 56-bit sums are exposed in one cycle, contributing to the 2689-port leaf interface.
issues.required_fix: Evaluate lane-serial or banked coefficient-engine consumption and cost its latency in the barrier recurrence.

allowed_claims: At the sealed exact SHA, directed VCS/SVA passes 61 synthetic tiles and compares 16 lane-local moment results per channel group.
The RTL contains 96 signed INT8 projection products and 32 Q8 squares per accepted beat, with 16 shared requant lanes over three data cycles per tile.
With continuous input and no output backpressure, the standalone input interface can accept one five-beat tile every five cycles.
The corrected logic-only DC point is 53662.139958 um2, 60910 cells and 9183 sequential cells with setup +0.1053 ns and hold +0.0001 ns at the stated ideal 3 ns constraints.
forbidden_claims: ties-to-even and saturation boundary coverage is complete
the DUT implements the fc1-to-Q8 early-requant bridge
the 21 synthetic channel groups prove complete H67 BN1 population semantics
3.33x from comparing rank3 right-only work with complete dense sn2
1.667x full rank3 arithmetic speedup before PAFT and implementation of correction plus left projection
M161 6.184x or 2.944x bit-movement sensitivities are cycles, energy, or speedup
53.66k um2 is placed/routed accelerator area or paper PPA
physical, network, system, or headline speedup
m164_priority: P0: add executable address-bearing maximum-population/barrier/replay model and freeze PAFT artifact identities
P1: shrink Q8 moment widths to universal 26/32/18 and projection storage to 19 bits, then rerun boundary VCS/DC
P1: remove tile_channel_start from the wide carry path
P1: prototype moment ownership and raw-to-requant bank fusion with an explicit backpressure/overlap contract
P1: add complete RNE boundary suite and sustained II counter
Only after PAFT: compare equivalent dense and complete rank3 pipelines in one cycle simulator
